metadata.change_process: Changes require approval from Platform Governance and Security in CODEOWNERS-reviewed PRs. Keep this list aligned with branch protection enforcement, CI job names, config/ci/branch-protection-gap.json, and the governance mirror docs/governance/branch-protection-required-checks.yml.
metadata.reconciliation_note: Branch-protection split reconciled: the declared contract is 17 universal required status checks (nine stable aggregate checks 01-repository-integrity .. 09-change-risk-and-approval plus the eight always-emitted legacy contexts that live GitHub branch protection currently enforces). The two remaining legacy contexts ('Security Gates Required', 'SDK Release Validation') are declared under conditional_status_checks because they cannot be enforced as universal branch-protection checks: 'Security Gates Required' is a PR-only fan-in (if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request') and 'SDK Release Validation' is emitted only by the path-filtered publish-sdk workflow; neither emits on merge_group, so requiring them would stall the merge queue on unrelated PRs. The nine aggregate contexts are not yet enforced on GitHub (enforced_baseline below); that migration is tracked and owned in config/ci/branch-protection-gap.json. The daily branch-protection-validation cron runs the validator WITHOUT the gap file so any declared-but-not-enforced context keeps the job red until the migration is actually applied.

enforced_baseline.note: Live GitHub enforces exactly these eight. The nine aggregate contexts are declared universal but not yet applied; each is recorded with an owner in config/ci/branch-protection-gap.json.

conditional_status_checks.reason: PR-only fan-in gate (if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'); it does not emit on merge_group, so it cannot be a universal branch-protection required check without stalling the merge queue.

Emitted only when sdk/python/** or the affected OpenAPI contracts change (pull_request paths filter); it does not emit on every PR and has no merge_group trigger, so it cannot be a universal branch-protection required check.
